entries.head: promql
entries.message: promql: 'bool' modifier is only allowed on comparison binary ops
entries.rationale: the parser rejects `bool` on non-comparison operators ("bool modifier can only be used on comparison operators"), so b.ReturnBool can never be true for the `or` BinaryExpr this function receives — a parser-level fact independent of which function calls it. Since cerberus issue #2528, lowerMixedExpHistogramFamily replaces lowerRoot as the direct caller (split out of lowerRoot's own body purely to keep that function's golangci-lint maintainability-index score over the repo's floor), and lowerLabelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, lowerMathFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, lowerMulOrDivScaleOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, lowerArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, lowerComparisonOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and lowerVectorVectorArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp remain the second through seventh callers (cerberus issue #2449) — all seven still hand this function the identical parser-produced BinaryExpr their own labelCallOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, mathFnOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, mulOrDivScaleOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp, arithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and comparisonOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp recognizers only ever matched via mixedExpHistogramSetOp — the same node lowerRoot's own dispatch (now lowerMixedExpHistogramFamily's) would have received — so the claim is unchanged, the same way lowerVectorSetOp's identical check for the float case and lowerExpHistogramSetOp's identical check for the both-histogram case already establish. lowerVectorVectorArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and the eighth caller, lowerComparisonVectorVectorOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp (cerberus issue #2449's vector-vector comparison piece), each call this function TWICE per query (once for each operand's own mixed `or`), but every call passes one of the two inner `or` BinaryExprs vectorVectorArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp / comparisonVectorVectorOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp matched via mixedExpHistogramSetOp — never the outer vector-vector BinaryExpr itself — so the identical reasoning holds for all four calls. In particular, comparisonOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's and lowerComparisonVectorVectorOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's own ReturnBool (set when the OUTER comparison carries `bool`) is never forwarded here: both callers pass only the inner `or` BinaryExpr mixedExpHistogramSetOp matched — the outer comparison's own BinaryExpr (whose ReturnBool may be true) is a distinct AST node this function never sees. lowerVectorPlainArithmeticOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp and the tenth caller, lowerComparisonVectorPlainOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp (cerberus issue #2449's final wrapper family: a mixed `or` operand paired with a plain, non-mixed vector), likewise call this function only ONCE per query, on the mixed side's own inner `or` BinaryExpr — mixedExpHistogramSetOp's own match on whichever of the outer BinaryExpr's two operands is mixed, never the outer plain-vs-mixed BinaryExpr itself, and never the plain operand, which is lowered separately via lowerPlainOperandForMixedJoin (histogram_native_mixed_or_vector_plain_arithmetic.go) — so the identical reasoning holds: lowerComparisonVectorPlainOverMixedExpHistogramSetOp's own ReturnBool (set when the OUTER comparison carries `bool`) is likewise never forwarded here.
